answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in ocean, expire in lagoon, and timber lists each expiry. Anyone running 159 aliases thus needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 987 identities would post 4237 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
